elements.element: The transition and data-return obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 14a applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: TrueLink must provide transition assistance for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(a) requires TrueLink, at Client's request, to “provide transition assistance for up to 6 months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at TrueLink's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(a) expressly states that transition assistance will be provided “at TrueLink's then-current rates.”

elements.element: TrueLink must return all Client data to Client within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(b) requires TrueLink to return to Client “all Client Content and other Client data” within 30 days after expiry or termination.

elements.element: Returned Client data must be in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(b) expressly requires return “in a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: TrueLink must delete the returned Client data after its return.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(c) requires TrueLink to “thereafter delete such Client Content and data from its systems.”

elements.element: TrueLink must certify the deletion to Client.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(c) requires TrueLink to “certify such deletion to Client in writing.”

elements.element: The transition-assistance and data-export obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 14a applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: TrueLink must provide transition assistance for at least the 90-day fallback period.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(a) provides transition assistance, at Client's request, for up to 6 months, which encompasses the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: TrueLink must export Client data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(b) requires return of all Client Content and other Client data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination.

result.reason: The operative redline fully implements the preferred position and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It adds only the transition-assistance, data-return, deletion, and certification mechanics needed for the preferred position and does not displace the Client's existing obligations to arrange replacement name-server and hosting services. Drafting quality is strong, although “thereafter” does not establish a specific deadline for deletion or certification; the stated preferred position likewise does not require one.
